faqs.question: Where does the formula D²/162 come from?
faqs.answer: It is derived from the cross-sectional area of a cylinder multiplied by the standard density of steel (7,850 kg/m³).

faqs.question: What is the standard commercial length of TMT rebar in India?
faqs.answer: Standard commercial bundle length is 12 meters (approx. 40 feet).

en.notes: Based on standard steel density of 7,850 kg/m³: Unit Weight (kg/m) = D² / 162.28, where D is bar diameter in millimeters.

faqs.question: D²/162という計算式の由来は？
faqs.answer: 円の断面積公式（πD²/4）に鉄の比重7.85を掛け合わせて導出した実用近似式です。

faqs.question: 鉄筋の定尺は何メートルですか？
faqs.answer: 土木・建築分野では通常5.5m〜12.0m（特に8m〜12m）が定尺として流通しています。
